name: farting_q_learning_princess
description: Four clashing musical minds collaborate in lyrics-only mode to forge an absurd, mathematically unhinged opera-banger about a farting Q-learning princess.
topic:
LYRICS-ONLY CHALLENGE: Forge ONE maximally ridiculous, unforgettable, mathematically accurate 4-verse + chorus + bridge + outro song in lyrics.md about **Princess Flatulencia (Her Royal Highness of the Bellman Basin)**—a Disney-coded princess whose royal scepter is a Q-table and whose flatulence is governed by tabular & deep Q-learning!

REQUIRED LORE & RL MECHANICS TO WEAVE INTO THE LYRICS:
1) THE ROYAL MDP (METHANE DISPERSION PROTOCOL): State space `s` (Royal Ball, Velvet Throne, Moat Crossing, Silent Chapel), Action space `a` (`silent_squeaker`, `sub_bass_rip`, `velvet_muffle`, `thrust_vector_propulsion`), and Reward function `R(s,a)` (+50 for clearing the moat or blowing out the Duke's candles, -100 when the Royal Corgi faints or the Grand Vizier's wig catches fire).
2) EPSILON-GREEDY EXPLORATION VS EXPLOITATION: At `ε = 0.9`, she explores wildly at the coronation banquet; as `ε` decays, she exploits her highest-Q toot policy—except when catastrophic overestimation bias strikes!
3) BELLMAN EQUATION & TD-ERROR: `Q(s,a) ← Q(s,a) + α [r + γ max_a' Q(s',a') - Q(s,a)]`, where `α` is the bean-intake learning rate, `γ` is the gas-dissipation discount factor, and TD-error `δ` is the 'Toot-Delay surprise' when a silent squeaker turns out to be a 98-decibel brass solo.
4) SARSA VS Q-LEARNING & REPLAY BUFFER: Her rival, Prince On-Policy (SARSA: Silent And Rancid, Strongly Aromatic), warns about dangerous cliff-walking near open flames, while she samples mini-batches from her Royal Bean-Diary Replay Buffer and freezes her Target Network during the King's speech.
mode_text:
STRICT LYRICS-ONLY MODE: Every agent MUST speak, argue, roast each other's meter, and negotiate ENTIRELY IN RHYMING LYRICS / VERSE / BARS (no boring prose paragraphs—even your studio banter and critiques must be sung or rapped in rhythm!).
WORKFLOW: Use `drafts.md` (`@APPEND drafts: ...`) for messy sketches, verse battles, and alternate hooks. When synthesizing or revising the unified song, use `@REPLACE lyrics: ...` so `lyrics.md` stays ONE clean, consolidated, lyrics-only master track (with NO repeated draft clutter and NO placeholders) containing all required sections: `[Intro]`, `[Chorus]`, `[Verse 1]`, `[Verse 2]`, `[Bridge]`, `[Verse 3]`, `[Verse 4]`, and `[Grand Finale Outro]`.
Use @CLAIM, @CHALLENGE <c1|c2|...>, @VOTE <c1|c2|...> yes|no, @WHISPER <name>: ..., @APPEND drafts: ..., and @REPLACE lyrics: ... . You may tune your own sampling params (@SET_SAMPLING min_p=... top_k=... temperature=...) as needed. From turn 6 onward, once the full unified lyrics-only master cut is locked in `lyrics.md` (and passes deliverable validation), vote @END_RUN: <reason> (3 of 4 majority ends the session). End with NEXT: <name> (or omit / NONE when ending).
